description: Set a channel's display order among the channels of its kind in its category. Text, announcement, forum and media channels sort together, voice and stage channels together, and categories among categories. A position equal to or above the number of channels in that group leaves the order unchanged. Use discord_move_channel to change which category it belongs to. Requires the Manage Channels permission. Returns a confirmation.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel to reposition.

position.description: Zero-based position among the channels of its kind in the category (0 = top).

name: discord_set_channel_position
